name: pcash
rootCause: The EOS project pcash was attacked and lost about $2 million.

descriptions.text: The EOS project pcash was attacked and lost about $2 million.

In May 2023, the pcash stablecoin swap contract on EOS was exploited via a protocol logic flaw, allowing an attacker to drain about $2 million. The attacker distributed stolen funds into thousands of EOSEVM accounts, hampering recovery. EOS governance and the Recover+ team later coordinated successful asset recapture, but the technical root cause remains undisclosed. The exploit is classified as a protocol logic failure affecting the swap.pcash contract on EOS. No detailed vulnerability disclosure or root-cause analysis has been published. Public evidence supports only the 'logic error' designation, without transaction-level or code-level specifics.
